caption: The drawing is a map of the Garden of André Parmentier, located in Brooklyn, N.Y., depicted within a tan triangular plot bordered by two labeled roads: "Jamaica Turnpike" on the left and "Flatbush Turnpike" on the right. The inner section of the garden is illustrated in soft brown, subdivided by curving and straight paths, with various circular and rectangular plots containing images of fruit, trees, or plants. Most prominent are clusters of purple grapes, green trees, and other fruits in colors of yellow, red, and orange, distributed throughout different areas of the garden. Each garden section is outlined by dotted green lines. To the lower right outside the map, a decorative vignette shows a green-leaved tree, a wooden garden tool, a basket full of red-and-yellow fruit, several yellow pumpkins, clusters of purple grapes, and scattered red, purple, and orange fruits against a cream background. The map includes compass directions at the top edge. The text "GARDEN OF ANDRÉ PARMENTIER BROOKLYN, N.Y." is written in black on the left side near the map’s base. The color scheme is primarily beige and brown for paths and soil, with accents of green for foliage, purple for grapes, and varied bright hues for other fruits.
title: Andre Parmentier Garden
